study_identification_part.si4_title: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Train a multimodal variational autoencoder (mmVAE) normative model on amyloid-negative cognitively unimpaired controls to quantify individual-level deviations across ATN biomarkers in the Alzheimer’s disease spectrum, derive a disease severity index (DSI), and evaluate its associations with dementia severity, cognition, and progression; replicate findings in an independent cohort.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The discovery dataset is ADNI and replication uses the Knight ADRC cohort.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: We constructed a discovery dataset consisting of individuals from ADNI and a replication dataset consisting of individuals from the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC...

rci2_hc_n.reason: Counts of amyloid-negative cognitively unimpaired reference groups are reported for both datasets.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: A total of 434 amyloid-negative CU participants were included in the reference control group (ADNI-CU)… For ADRC, the reference group (ADRC-CU) consisted of 301 amyloid-negative CU individuals.

rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: ADNI participants underwent amyloid-PET imaging with either [18F]Florbetapir (FBP) … and tau-PET imaging with [18F]-Flortaucipir (FTP)… participants were required to have T1-weighted MRI.

nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: mmVAE was conditioned on the age and sex… To avoid harmonization issues due to multiple tracers, we only included data collected using FBP…

caa6_deviation_metric.answer: Reconstruction error-based regional Z-scores (standardized using CU-holdout); abnormality defined at |Z|>1.96 (MRI: Z<-1.96; PET: Z>1.96); binary abnormality maps; DSI summarizing extent and magnitude.
caa6_deviation_metric.reason: Methods describe deviation computation, normalization to Z-scores, and thresholds; DSI combines abnormal extent and magnitude.
caa6_deviation_metric.supporting_text: …normalize regional deviations… to generate modality-specific Z-score deviations… Z-scores below -1.96 (MRI) and above 1.96 (amyloid/tau) labeled abnormal…

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Linear regression adjusted for age and sex relating DSI (overall and modality-specific) to neuropsychological composites (memory, executive functioning, language); survival analysis (Kaplan–Meier, log-rank) assessing progression to CDR≥1 by DSI quantiles; group comparisons across CDR stages with effect sizes.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Multimodal normative deviations and the derived DSI capture individual heterogeneity across ATN, increase with dementia severity, correlate with cognitive impairment, and stratify progression risk; results replicate in an independent cohort.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: In ADNI, DSI_all increased across CDR stages (CU-test mean=0.06, 95% CI [0.007–0.10]; preclinical AD=0.45 [0.39–0.52]; CDR=0.5=1.1 [0.87–1.25]; CDR≥1=1.8 [1.31–2.26]; pairwise differences FDR<0.05 except 0.5 vs ≥1). ADRC showed similar trends (CU-test=0.006 [0.002–0.008]; preclinical=0.21 [0.12–0.37]; 0.5=0.32 [0.21–0.50]). Higher DSI_all associated with worse cognition (e.g., ADNI memory r≈-0.62, p<0.001), and higher DSI quantiles exhibited greater risk of progression to CDR≥1 in survival analyses.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Conditioned on age/sex; multimodal mmVAE with POE combines modalities; standardized deviations via CU-holdout; thresholded abnormality maps; DSI quantifies extent and magnitude; restricted to FBP tracer to avoid harmonization; transfer learning for cross-cohort replication.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Cohort demographic differences (age/sex) and North America-only samples may limit generalizability; transfer learning cannot fully address domain shifts; future work should include longitudinal cohorts and broader, more diverse populations.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: ROIs: 90 per modality (270 total features). PET SUVR normalization: ADNI—whole cerebellum (amyloid) and inferior cerebellar gray (tau); ADRC—cerebellum cortex for both.
